mentions.name: Astro Starter Template
mentions.description: An Astro starter template for launching a high-quality blog that uses no JavaScript by default and relies only on HTML and CSS, with no extra frameworks or styling libraries. Blog content is written as Markdown or .mdx files for easy porting, and the resulting static site can be hosted for free on major providers such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare.
mentions.problem: Starting a high-quality blog is difficult, and many tools add bloat through JavaScript frameworks and styling libraries.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building the easiest way to start your own high-quality blog: https://github.com/BryanHogan/astro-starter-template

mentions.name: Astro Starter Template
mentions.description: A starter template for the Astro framework that provides a reusable base for new web projects, staying close to HTML and CSS while incorporating features such as scoped components, layouts, and easy Markdown blog integration.
mentions.problem: Many things keep repeating with every website built in Astro, so a shared base is needed for new web projects.
